Sapporo 110 places · area 1 of 9

Ōdōri · Susukino · Nijō Market · Maruyama · Moiwa · Jōzankei

  1. 1 Must see within Sapporo

    Ōdōri Park (大通公園)

    The 1.5 km green firebreak that splits Sapporo north from south — stage of the Sapporo Snow Festival in February, beer gardens and the autumn food festival.

    Look for ★ Anime & pop culture — Hatsune Miku / Snow Miku — the Snow Miku snow statue has stood at the Sapporo Snow Festival's Ōdōri 11-chōme site for 17 years (2026: 'Sweet Snow Ver.' plus Oshi no Ko & Medalist statues, KADOKAWA) · odori park snow festival

    Ōdōri Nishi 1–12-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0042, Japan

    Recommended by , , +1,

  2. 2 Must see within Sapporo · Ramen

    Menya Saimi (麺屋彩未)

    The miso-ramen counter Sapporo queues for — three white misos over a clear pork-bone broth, a dab of grated ginger on the chāshū. Michelin Bib Gourmand (Hokkaido 2017) and Tabelog Ramen Hokkaido 100 (2024).

    5-3-12 Misono 10-jō, Toyohira-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 062-0010, Japan

    Recommended by , , +1,

  3. 3 Must see within Sapporo

    Sapporo Clock Tower (札幌市時計台)

    The 1878 wooden drill hall of the Sapporo Agricultural College, its clock still striking the hours — the city's symbol and an Important Cultural Property.

    Look for clock tower

    Kita 1-jo Nishi 2-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0001, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  4. 4 Must see within Sapporo

    Former Hokkaido Government Office (Akarenga, 赤れんが庁舎)

    The 1888 neo-baroque red-brick seat of the Hokkaido Development Commission — reopened 25 July 2025 after a multi-year restoration as a museum of Hokkaido history with a free garden.

    Look for red brick government office

    Kita 3-jo Nishi 6-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-8588, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  5. 5 Must see within Sapporo

    Moerenuma Park (モエレ沼公園)

    Isamu Noguchi's last great work: a former landfill sculpted into one park-sized artwork — Mt Moere, the Glass Pyramid, the Sea Fountain.

    Look for isamu noguchi art park

    1-1 Moerenuma-kōen, Higashi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 007-0011, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  6. 6 Must see within Sapporo

    Nijō Market (二条市場)

    A city block of crab, uni, ikura and fish stalls since the Meiji era, with kaisendon counters and the Noren Yokochō drinking alley.

    Look for seafood market

    Minami 3-jō Higashi 1–2-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  7. 7 Must see within Sapporo

    Hokkaido University — Poplar & Ginkgo Avenues (北海道大学 札幌キャンパス)

    The 1876 Sapporo Agricultural College campus, 7 minutes from the station — the 1903 Poplar Avenue (replanted after the 2004 typhoon), the ginkgo avenue, and a 1929 scratch-tile museum of 3 million specimens.

    Look for university campus

    7 minutes walk from JR Sapporo Station, Kita-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  8. 8 Must see within Sapporo · Ramen

    Aji no Sanpei (味の三平)

    Where miso ramen was born in 1955 — the owner took his cue from miso soup.

    Daimaru Fujii Central 4F, Minami 1-jō Nishi 3-chōme 2, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 060-0061, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  9. 9 Must see within Sapporo · Hokkaido seafood

    Jingisukan Hitsujikai no Mise Itadakimasu (羊飼いの店 いただきます。)

    A Susukino jingisukan run by an owner who took up shepherding to supply it — rare cuts of purebred Hokkaido Suffolk on the domed grill.

    Minami 5-jō Nishi 5-1-6, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  10. 10 Must see within Sapporo · Ramen

    Menya Yukikaze Susukino Honten (麺屋 雪風 すすきの本店)

    No. 3 in MAPPLE's Sapporo ramen top 30 — a rich-yet-clean 'nōkō miso' of pork-bone and chicken paitan with curly medium noodles.

    Susukino, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  11. 11 Must see within Sapporo · Ramen

    Ebisoba Ichigen Sōhonten (えびそば一幻 総本店)

    Sapporo's prawn-ramen original, burning through ~60 kg of shrimp heads a day; pick your broth from pure shrimp to half pork-bone.

    Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  12. 12 Must see within Sapporo · Wagashi

    Snow Brand Parlor Sapporo Honten (雪印パーラー 札幌本店)

    Sapporo's 1961 dairy parlour: 30-plus parfaits and the 'Snow Royal' ice cream first made for a 1968 imperial visit.

    Taiyō Seimei Sapporo Bldg 1F, Kita 2-jō Nishi 3-1-31, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by , ,

  13. 13 Must see within Sapporo

    Mount Moiwa (藻岩山)

    Ropeway and mini-cable car to a 531 m summit for one of Japan's 'new three great night views' over the Sapporo grid.

    Look for night view ropeway

    Moiwayama, Minami-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  14. 14 Must see within Sapporo

    Hokkaido Shrine (北海道神宮)

    Hokkaido's principal Shinto shrine in the Maruyama primeval forest, founded 1869 for the island's pioneer deities — cherry and plum blossom in spring.

    Look for shrine maruyama

    474 Miyagaoka, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 064-8505, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  15. 15 Must see within Sapporo

    ES CON FIELD HOKKAIDO — Hokkaido Ballpark F Village (エスコンフィールドHOKKAIDO)

    The Fighters' 2023 retractable-roof ballpark at the heart of a 32-ha 'F Village' — with TOWER 11's natural hot spring and sauna overlooking the field; parts open free on non-game days.

    Hokkaido Ballpark F Village, Kitahiroshima, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  16. 16 Must see within Sapporo · Ramen

    Sumire Susukino (すみれ 札幌すすきの店)

    The Murakami family house (1964) that codified the lard-sealed, scalding Sapporo miso bowl; the late-night Susukino branch pours the Nakanoshima honten broth. Tabelog Ramen Hokkaido 100 2024 & 2025.

    Pixis Bldg 2F, Minami 3-jō Nishi 3-9-2, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  17. 17 Must see within Sapporo · Hokkaido seafood

    Jingisukan Daruma Honten (だるま本店)

    The Susukino jingisukan room since 1954 — a cast-iron dome at every seat, one cut of mutton, sweet-spicy dipping sauce, a queue from 17:30. Cash only.

    Crystal Bldg 1F, Minami 5-jō Nishi 4, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido 064-0805, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  18. 18 Must see within Sapporo · Hokkaido seafood

    Soup Curry Garaku (スープカレー GARAKU)

    Numbered tickets and daily lines for a soup curry whose broth borrows udon-shop dashi technique — pork bone and herbs stewed two days, kelp and bonito layered in.

    Okumura Bldg B1F, Minami 2-jō Nishi 2-6-1, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  19. 19 Must see within Sapporo · Hokkaido seafood

    Sapporo Beer Garden (サッポロビール園)

    Restaurants spread through the garden serve fresh-lamb jingisukan and seasonal Hokkaido produce with Sapporo draught — Kessel Hall does all-you-can-eat-and-drink.

    Higashi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan (beside the Sapporo Beer Museum)

    Recommended by ,

  20. 20 Must see within Sapporo · Sushi

    Sushi Zen Honten (すし善 本店)

    The grand old name in Sapporo sushi — an all-hinoki house with several counters and private rooms, Hokkaido fish handled with Edomae technique.

    Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan (honten)

    Recommended by ,

  21. 21 Must see within Sapporo · Ramen

    Sapporo Miso Ramen Senmonten Keyaki Susukino Honten (けやき すすきの本店)

    The miso-only Susukino counter with a permanent queue — an unclouded broth of pork knuckle, stewing hen and vegetables simmered over ten hours.

    Susukino, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  22. 22 Must see within Sapporo · Hokkaido seafood

    Magic Spice Sapporo Honten (マジックスパイス 札幌本店)

    The shop that named 'soup curry' — a broth of about twenty spices built on the idea that food is medicine, ordered by escalating heat levels.

    Hongō-dōri 8-chōme Minami 6-2, Shiroishi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  23. 23 Must see within Sapporo · Hokkaido seafood

    Okushiba Shōten Ekimae Sōseiji (奥芝商店 駅前創成寺)

    Soup curry rebuilt around a sweet, rich shrimp-head dashi, piled with Hokkaido vegetables — the chain's station-side temple-themed branch.

    Hokuren Bldg B1F, Kita 4-jō Nishi 1-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan

    Recommended by ,

  24. 24 Must see within Sapporo · Hokkaido seafood

    Tsukisappu Jingisukan Club (ツキサップじんぎすかんクラブ)

    Fresh mutton over charcoal in clay braziers, at a ranch-side club that began in 1953 as members-only.

How we choose

Every place is recommended by named sources (review-aggregator star ratings never count as the recommender), pinned to its door from a published coordinate, and status-checked. Closed places stay, flagged, so you know they’re gone.

Must see
The places to plan a visit around — graded within each area, not across the city.
Worth the detour
Strong picks, worth going out of your way for.
Deep cut
For the curious: smaller, odder, more local.

Within each area, places are ordered by tier, then by number of named sources — never by popularity. We don’t add ratings, prices or opening hours of our own. Any quoted in a write-up are the source’s, dated.

Follow changes — an RSS feed of every closure and status check in this guide, for any feed reader.

228 sights and 184 places to eat across Hokkaido — from Sapporo's Clock Tower and Moiwa night view to the onsen, lakes and coasts beyond — every one traceable to its source.

How this guide was made

How the cuisine filters were policed

Every food card names a specific dish — a label alone doesn’t qualify. A cuisine tag names the kitchen’s own tradition, never one dish it serves. Tabelog and Retty scores may measure popularity but never count as a source.

Web-searched in Japanese and English, fact-checked

Every place is traceable to two credible sources, or a lone Michelin / UNESCO / Agency for Cultural Affairs designation — recorded in data/sources.json. Every coordinate is verified into data/geocodes.json and every place status-checked open. Yelp/TripAdvisor/Tabelog never count toward the two-source bar.
